第2091章 冰璇月的担忧（第1页）
听到这个声音萧天明显的一愣！他实在是想不明白为什么这个时候冰璇月找自己是为什么事情。
不过既然是冰璇月找，那必然是有要紧事！
于是萧天就快速向着冰璇月所在的院落方向走去。
一步万里，两步萧天的身影就彻底的消失在原地。
下一刻，萧天就出现在了冰璇月的院落之中。
“冰姐姐，找我什么事？”萧天走了进去，然后就顺手抱住了冰璇月。
冰璇月也是象征性的挣扎了一下，然后就顺势的倒在了萧天的怀中。
感受着萧天那温暖的怀抱，心中也是变得越发的平静。
片刻之后，冰璇月说道“夫君之前跟你说过的，我的敌人估计很快就会找过来，而且我想不少的大势力都会想尽办法送强者过来，这一次可能会更加的危险！”
这话冰璇月并没有任何的夸张，而是真实的情况。
“没事！只要他们敢乱来我就收拾他们！”萧天不以为然的说道。
如今萧天的修为已经是阳神境一层巅峰。
即便是他们那些从九天十地过来的强者萧天也是有信心可以胜过那些强者。
感受到萧天的自信，冰璇月也是无奈的说道“我知道夫君你现在的实力强大，一般的阳神境巅峰根本不是你的对手，但是那些强者可不简单，基本都是比我更加强大的存在，手段更是层出不穷。要是以前的我，我也不一定有信心可以击败那些人！”
冰璇月说的是以前的自己，而不是现在的自己。
如今的冰璇月修炼萧天提供的顶级功法，战力自然不是同一境界的强者可以比拟的。
加上这里的神元更加的强大，修炼出来的神力更加的强横，所有这也是战力更加强大的重要原因。

“放心吧！我现在也是在努力提升着修为！只要我的修为在突破一些，战胜那些强者应该不成问题。”萧天笑着说道。
听到这话，冰璇月也是点点头，这点还是非常的准确。
只要萧天再次突破，那战力必然变得更加的强横。
而要达到这个目标其实也不是很难。
“而且我现在已经突破到阳神境，我想可以通过渡雷罚，再让自己突破到更高阳神境应该是没有问题的。”萧天笑着说道。
“嗯，这倒也是！那准备什么时候渡劫？”冰璇月问道。
“等这一次修炼完吧！我的目标是先突破到阳神境三层然后再突破。”萧天笑着说道。
“好！那到时我跟你出去！”冰璇月开口道。
上一次没有人跟着萧天一起去渡劫，差点酿成大祸。
这一次，无论如何都不可能让萧天一个人去渡劫。
“放心吧！这一次我肯定不会是一个人，当然了，还不需要用到冰姐姐你这个一步。”萧天笑着说道。
“我们之间还用那么见外吗？”冰璇月笑着说道。
“当然不是了！主要是我不想让姐姐你出来，那样我太吃亏了！”萧天笑着说道。
而萧天再说话的时候，也是看向冰璇月那充满诱惑的身体，意思已经非常明显了。
“吃什么亏！我穿厚一些不就好了嘛！”冰璇月红着脸无奈的说道。
“这怎么够！而且我准备大白虎和小金出去。有他们两个在我想绝对是万无一失。”笑着说道。
有着这两头神兽在，绝对可以保证萧天的安全。
也就没有继续要求萧天必须带上她了....

Chapter 2091 Bingxuanyue’s worries (page 1)
Xiao Tian was obviously startled when he heard this voice! He really couldn't figure out why Bing Xuanyue was looking for him at this time.
But since Bing Xuanyue is looking for him, there must be something important!
So Xiao Tian quickly walked towards the courtyard where Bing Xuanyue was.
One step for thousands of miles, two steps for Xiao Tian's figure to completely disappear from the spot.
The next moment, Xiao Tian appeared in Bing Xuanyue's courtyard.
"Sister Bing, what do you want from me?" Xiao Tian walked in and hugged Bing Xuanyue.
Bing Xuanyue also struggled symbolically, and then fell into Xiao Tian's arms.
Feeling Xiao Tian's warm embrace, my heart became calmer and calmer.
After a while, Bing Xuanyue said, "My husband has told you before, my enemies will probably come soon, and I think many big forces will try their best to send strong men over. This time it may be even more dangerous!"
What Bing Xuanyue said was not an exaggeration, but the truth.
"It's okay! As long as they dare to mess around, I will deal with them!" Xiao Tian said disapprovingly.
Now Xiao Tian's cultivation level is already at the peak of the first level of Yangshen Realm.
Even Xiao Tian, ​​their strong men who came from Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, was confident that he could defeat those strong men.
Feeling Xiao Tian's confidence, Bing Xuanyue said helplessly, "I know, husband, that you are very powerful now. The average person at the peak of the Yang God Realm is not your opponent at all, but those strong people are not simple. They are basically more powerful beings than me, and their methods are endless. If it were me before, I might not have the confidence to defeat those people!"
Bing Xuanyue was talking about her past self, not her current self.
Nowadays, Bing Xuanyue practices the top-notch skills provided by Xiao Tian, ​​and her combat power is naturally not comparable to that of strong men in the same realm.
In addition, the divine energy here is more powerful and the divine power cultivated is more powerful. All this is also an important reason for the stronger combat power.
"Don't worry! I am also working hard to improve my cultivation! As long as my cultivation is making breakthroughs, it shouldn't be a problem to defeat those strong ones." Xiao Tian said with a smile.
Hearing this, Bing Xuanyue also nodded, this point is still very accurate.
As long as Xiao Tian breaks through again, his combat power will inevitably become more powerful.
And it is actually not difficult to achieve this goal.
"And now that I have broken through to the Yang God Realm, I think it will be no problem to break through to a higher Yang God Realm through the Thunder Crossing Punishment." Xiao Tian said with a smile.
"Well, that's true! When will you prepare to overcome the tribulation?" Bing Xuanyue asked.
"Wait until this training is completed! My goal is to break through to the third level of Yangshen Realm first and then break through again." Xiao Tian said with a smile.
"Okay! Then I'll go out with you!" Bing Xuanyue said.
The last time no one followed Xiao Tian to overcome the tribulation, it almost caused a catastrophe.
This time, it is impossible for Xiao Tian to go through the disaster alone.
"Don't worry! I will definitely not be alone this time. Of course, I don't need to take this step like Sister Bing." Xiao Tian said with a smile.
"Do we still have to be so open to each other?" Bing Xuanyue said with a smile.
"Of course not! The main reason is that I don't want you, sister, to come out. That would be a huge disadvantage for me!" Xiao Tian said with a smile.
When Xiao Tian spoke again, he also looked at Bing Xuanyue's tempting body, and his meaning was already very obvious.
"Why should I suffer! It would be better if I wore thicker clothes!" Bing Xuanyue said helplessly with a red face.
"How can this be enough! And I'm going to prepare the big white tiger and the little oneKim out. With the two of them here, I think it will be absolutely foolproof. "Said with a smile.
With the presence of these two divine beasts, Xiao Tian's safety can definitely be guaranteed.
He didn't continue to ask Xiao Tian to take her with him...
